## load libraries
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
weightGainAnalysis <- read_xlsx("~/Desktop/DATA 211/weightGainData.xlsx")
weightGainAnalysis

normalWeight <- weightGainAnalysis$weight[1:7]
increasedWeight <- weightGainAnalysis$weight[8:14]

## 2-sample T-test
t.test(increasedWeight, normalWeight, alternative = "greater")


```

```{r}
# Line Graph: Daily Weight
# Add a column named 'Day' with values 1 to 14
weightGainAnalysis$Day <- 1:14

ggplot(data=weightGainAnalysis, aes(x=Day, y=weight))+
  geom_line(color="blue", linetype="dotdash")+
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2)+
  labs(title="weight over 14 days",x="Day", y=("Weight(lbs)"))



```
